description: Scoped macOS keyboard regression journeys verified at 458f923 after the owner disabled a conflicting system shortcut. Native event delivery is exercised; physical pen, general accessibility, all field contexts and pixel equivalence are separate coverage.

cases.expected: Fresh and bound Command-Shift-S opens Save As; cancellation preserves destination, bytes and title, and ordinary Save remains bound
Native width-field Undo/Redo changes text; Delete, tool letters and Space preserve selected drawing bytes and tool selection
Keyboard Undo removes one committed stroke in a fresh serialized snapshot and Redo restores its exact bytes
